index 0000000..671659d

+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+---
+- name: install an older collection for upgrade testing
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:1.0.0 -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+
+- name: upgrade to the newest stable version
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 --upgrade -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: upgraded_collection
+
+- name: confirm the collection was upgraded
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' to\" in upgraded_collection.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat upgrade without reinstalling
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 -U -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: confirm repeat upgrade is idempotent
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Skipping 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' as it is already installed\" in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' to\" not in repeated_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: include prereleases when upgrading
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 --upgrade --pre -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: prerelease_upgrade
+
+- name: confirm prerelease was selected
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1' to\" in prerelease_upgrade.stdout"
+
+- name: create a constrained requirements file
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '<1.0.9'
+
+- name: upgrade using a requirements file and constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_requirements.yml' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+  register: constrained_upgrade
+
+- name: confirm the constraint was respected
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.0' to\" in constrained_upgrade.stdout"

     assert display_msgs[1] == "Starting collection install process"

     assert display_msgs[3] == "ansible_namespace.collection:0.1.0 was installed successfully"
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('allow_pre_release, expected', [(False, '2.0.0'), (True, '3.0.0-beta.1')])
+def test_upgrade_resolves_newest_allowed_parent_and_required_dependency(monkeypatch, allow_pre_release, expected):
+    """An upgrade replaces the requested collection and only dependencies that no longer satisfy it."""
+    class LocalProxy:
+        def __init__(self, apis, manager):
+            pass
+
+        def get_collection_versions(self, requirement):
+            versions = {
+                'ns.parent': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0-beta.1'],
+                'ns.dep': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+                'ns.stable': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+            }
+            return [(version, None) for version in versions[requirement.fqcn]]
+
+        def get_collection_dependencies(self, candidate):
+            if candidate.fqcn != 'ns.parent':
+                return {}
+            if candidate.ver == '1.0.0':
+                return {'ns.dep': '>=1.0.0', 'ns.stable': '>=1.0.0'}
+            return {'ns.dep': '>=2.0.0', 'ns.stable': '>=1.0.0'}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', LocalProxy)
+    installed = [Candidate('ns.parent', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy'),
+                 Candidate('ns.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy'),
+                 Candidate('ns.stable', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    requested = [Requirement('ns.parent', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    # With --pre the prerelease is still below 3.0.0.
+    resolved = collection._resolve_depenency_map(
+        requested, [], MagicMock(), installed, False, allow_pre_release, upgrade=True,
+    )
+    assert resolved['ns.parent'].ver == expected
+    assert resolved['ns.dep'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert resolved['ns.stable'].ver == '1.0.0'
+
+
+def test_install_without_upgrade_does_not_replace_incompatible_installed_dependency(monkeypatch):
+    class LocalProxy:
+        def __init__(self, apis, manager):
+            pass
+
+        def get_collection_versions(self, requirement):
+            return [('2.0.0', None)]
+
+        def get_collection_dependencies(self, candidate):
+            return {'ns.dep': '>=2.0.0'} if candidate.fqcn == 'ns.parent' else {}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', LocalProxy)
+    requested = [Requirement('ns.parent', '>=2.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    installed = [Candidate('ns.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    with pytest.raises(InconsistentCandidate):
+        collection._resolve_depenency_map(requested, [], MagicMock(), installed, False, False, upgrade=False)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('allow_pre_release, expected', [(False, '2.0.0'), (True, '3.0.0-beta.1')])
+def test_upgrade_resolves_newest_allowed_parent_and_required_dependency(monkeypatch, allow_pre_release, expected):
+    """An upgrade replaces the requested collection and only dependencies that no longer satisfy it."""
+    class LocalProxy:
+        def __init__(self, apis, manager):
+            pass
+
+        def get_collection_versions(self, requirement):
+            versions = {
+                'ns.parent': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '3.0.0-beta.1'],
+                'ns.dep': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+                'ns.stable': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+            }
+            return [(version, None) for version in versions[requirement.fqcn]]
+
+        def get_collection_dependencies(self, candidate):
+            if candidate.fqcn != 'ns.parent':
+                return {}
+            if candidate.ver == '1.0.0':
+                return {'ns.dep': '>=1.0.0', 'ns.stable': '>=1.0.0'}
+            return {'ns.dep': '>=2.0.0', 'ns.stable': '>=1.0.0'}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dependency_resolution, 'MultiGalaxyAPIProxy', LocalProxy)
+    installed = [Candidate('ns.parent', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy'),
+                 Candidate('ns.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy'),
+                 Candidate('ns.stable', '1.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    requested = [Requirement('ns.parent', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    # With --pre the prerelease is still below 3.0.0.
+    resolved = collection._resolve_depenency_map(
+        requested, [], MagicMock(), installed, False, allow_pre_release, upgrade=True,
+    )
+    assert resolved['ns.parent'].ver == expected
+    assert resolved['ns.dep'].ver == '2.0.0'
+    assert resolved['ns.stable'].ver == '1.0.0'
+
